correctness.rationale: The exact small-ball renewal identities follow from the inverse images lying in the two affine endpoint branches. Strict convexity of each characteristic sum gives a unique positive root. The upper and lower r^s barriers are proved by a compact maximum/minimum principle with W(0)=0 and strictly positive stationary mass on the outer strip (full support). These yield exact logarithmic local dimensions, and Tonelli yields both strict negative-moment thresholds. Root ordering follows by comparing the characteristic functions at positive s. No critical exponent moment is asserted.

value.rationale: The two exact endpoint local dimensions are natural measure-theoretic invariants of the full-support stationary state studied in the cited nonresonant paper, distinct from the global Hausdorff-dimension estimate. They quantify sharp availability of inverse-power boundary observables and reveal a strict bias-sensitive asymmetry even when the two maps are geometric reflections. This answers an intrinsically motivated invariant question for a published open nonresonant parameter family rather than sampling arbitrary parameters.
